correctness.rationale: Both compact strategy spaces are [-1,1]; U1_xx=U2_yy=-1. The second best response y=x-x^3 lies in [-2/(3sqrt(3)),2/(3sqrt(3))], so for 0<=epsilon<=1/8 the first best response x=y+epsilon is interior. The unique mutual best response solves x^3=epsilon and y=x-epsilon. The epsilon^{-2/3} difference quotient diverges at zero despite uniqueness; the FOC Jacobian [[-1,1],[1,-1]] has determinant 0. Boundaries, one-sided parameter range, normalization and uniqueness are explicit, not inferred from the verifier.
